title: Perplexity with a Padding Mask
signature: def perplexity(logprobs: np.ndarray, mask: np.ndarray) -> float
hints: Perplexity is exp of the average negative log-likelihood per real token.
Average over all real tokens in the batch together, not per sequence.
Padded positions can hold -inf, and 0 * -inf is nan. Select with np.where(mask, logprobs, 0.0) instead of multiplying.
